panels.title: AP 当前状态明细

targets.expr: nexora_hw_component_state{job="platform_hardware_inventory",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",role=~"$role",hostname=~"$device",source_type=~"librenms_rule|librenms_mib_rule",component_class="wireless_access_point"}

panels.description: 列出所有纳管 AP 的实时在线状态与基础信息，失联 AP 会高亮标出。

panels.title: AP 关联终端 Top 20

targets.expr: topk(20, max by (site_name,vendor,role,hostname,device_id,ap_id,ap_mac,ap_name,ap_ip,ap_model) (nexora_wireless_sensor_value{job="platform_hardware_inventory",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",role=~"$role",hostname=~"$device",source_type=~"librenms_rule|librenms_mib_rule",component_class="wireless_access_point",sensor_class="clients"}))

panels.description: 按当前接入终端数由高到低排列，快速定位高密度接入区域。

panels.title: AP 在线时长 Top 20（天）
